meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目新版本发布到 npm 并验证发布产物
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要一键把代码包发布到 npm 并确认发布成功
copy.tagline_en: Publish a new version of your project to npm and verify the outputs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ship a code package to npm and confirm it succeeded

howto.what: Claude 会变成发布管理员:先确认要提升的版本号,再同步代码、触发自动发布流程、等待它成功,然后确认新版本已生成、写好发布说明、在聊天群发公告,并核对软件包版本。它只做发布,不审查或修复代码。
howto.when: 当你说出“publish”“release”“deploy”等发布指令,或要求发 npm 包时触发。你还必须指定版本号类型 patch/minor/major,否则它会先停下来询问。

say.text: 发布一个新版本,patch 类型
say.note: 把版本从 1.1.7 升到 1.1.8,并走完整发布流程。

say.text: 帮我发一个 minor 版本
say.note: 发布向后兼容的新功能,版本号第二位加一。

say.text: 部署 major 版本到 npm
say.note: 包含破坏性变更,版本号第一位加一。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as release manager: confirms bump type, syncs code, triggers GitHub Actions publish, waits for success, verifies release + npm versions, writes notes, posts to Discord. Publishes only; never reviews or repairs code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'publish', 'release', 'deploy' or similar release commands, or ask to publish to npm. You must provide a bump type (patch/minor/major), otherwise Claude stops and asks first.

say_en.note: Bumps version from 1.1.7 to 1.1.8 and runs the full flow.

say_en.text: Release a minor version for me.
say_en.note: Adds backward-compatible features; increments the second digit.

say_en.text: Deploy a major version to npm.
say_en.note: Includes breaking changes; increments the first digit.
